_meta.purpose: MISC Starlancer MAX ship + zone definitions.
_meta.axis_convention: Width = port-to-starboard (X). Length = ramp-end to forward (Y). Height = floor up (Z). All units are 1.25 m cubes.
_meta.ramp_note: The Starlancer MAX has a single cargo bay loaded via the rear ramp, so every zone uses ramp_side='low_y' (Y=0 = rear ramp edge).
_meta.render_note: ship_forward_y='high' — high local-Y points toward the nose, so the bay renders un-flipped with the rear ramp at the bottom of the diagram.
_meta.PROPOSED_LAYOUT_REVIEW_ME: DRAFT numbers — total 224 SCU split into 4 equal strips (2 wide x 7 long x 4 high = 56 SCU each). Correct the zone count / dimensions / SCU once the in-game cargo grid is confirmed.

zones.notes: Main bay, port column. Loaded via the rear ramp (Y=0 = rear edge).
